name: Panafic Industrials Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, Panafic Industrials Ltd is a Non-Banking Financial Company[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
PIL's principal operation, as an NBFC, is to finance industrial enterprises by providing loans and advances, primarily to private companies in India, and to other individuals. The company is also engaged in the purchase and sale of 
securities, dealing in shares, stocks, debentures, bonds, and other financial investments.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.68 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 0.93% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.54% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
